title: Kennedy Payload Hazardous Servicing Facility Roman Upgrades
summary: NASA records specific air-shower, HVAC, compressed-air, and crane work preparing Kennedy's Payload Hazardous Servicing Facility for the Roman Space Telescope.
key_findings: The facility supports clean-room and hazardous-material spacecraft processing.
NASA identifies completed or underway upgrades tied to a named mission's processing requirements.
The article distinguishes facility preparation from later spacecraft processing, launch, and mission outcome.
why_it_matters: It links a specific physical facility upgrade to a downstream mission-use case.
ftfn_relevance: Adds project-level facility evidence below the master-plan layer.
Connects infrastructure condition to payload processing requirements.
Creates later acceptance, processing, and mission-use checks.
evidence_limits: The article does not establish final acceptance for every upgrade.
It does not prove completed spacecraft processing, launch, or mission success.
